app.title: Familia Nieto. Cuentas Claras
app.description: Un espacio compartido para dar seguimiento de los gastos compartidos, con saldos separados en USD y MXN

auth.loginDescription: Use your family email address to receive a magic link. No password needed.
auth.genericResponse: If this email is registered with your family, a sign-in link will arrive shortly.
auth.unconfigured: Please contact the person setting up your family’s account.
auth.invalidLink: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
auth.denied: This account cannot access the family. Sign out and use your registered family email.
auth.unavailable: We could not check your family access. Try again.
auth.signOutFailed: We could not sign you out. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Your family space
dashboard.empty: No tabs yet. Create one for a trip or shared property.
dashboard.createFailed: We could not create this tab. Please try again.

expenses.loadFailed: We could not load this page. Please try again.
expenses.empty: No expenses in this tab yet.
expenses.currencyNote: Each expense keeps its own currency. USD and MXN are never combined.
expenses.participantsHint: Select each member once. The person who paid does not have to participate.
expenses.saveFailed: We could not save this expense. Your entries are still here; please try again.
expenses.writeDenied: Only the expense creator or the person who paid may edit or delete this expense.
expenses.deleteConfirm: Delete this expense and all its shares? This cannot be undone.
expenses.deleteFailed: We could not delete this expense. Please try again.
expenses.resetWarning: Changing the amount, currency, person who paid, or split restarts payment confirmation. The person who paid has their own share settled if they participate.
expenses.notFound: This page could not be found.

validation.descriptionRequired: Enter a description to preview the split.
validation.amountInvalid: Enter a nonnegative amount with up to two decimal places, without commas or currency symbols.
validation.payeeRequired: Choose a family member who paid.
validation.duplicateMember: Each member can appear only once.
validation.customInvalid: Enter valid amounts for every selected member that add up exactly to the total.
validation.percentageInvalid: Enter nonnegative percentages for every selected member that add up exactly to 100.

payments.title: Settle up
payments.note: Balances include payments awaiting confirmation. USD and MXN stay separate; obligations are not cancelled against each other.
payments.failed: We could not update this payment. Reload the latest shares and try again.
payments.denied: This payment is no longer available to you. Reload to check the latest shares.
